2609.31450.title: From Reward Signal to Visual Utility: A Controlled Audit of Medical VLM Post-Training
2609.31450.paper_summary: Medical vision-language model (VLM) post-training is commonly evaluated through answer accuracy. We examine how changes in accuracy and training objectives relate to image-conditioned decisions in a controlled Qwen2.5-VL-3B study on PMC-VQA. We compare supervised fine-tuning (SFT) with low-rank adaptation (LoRA) restricted to the language model, expanded multimodal adaptation scopes, standard answer-only Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), and a counterfactual evidence objective. On 2,000 clean-test questions, language model LoRA SFT changes correct-image accuracy by +1.10 percentage points (95% paired bootstrap CI:-0.85 to +3.05), while visual-benefit events decrease by 2.40 points and image sensitivity decreases by 5.60 points. Paired records reveal 155 acquired and 203 lost visual-benefit events. Broader adaptation yields lower correct-image accuracy than language-model LoRA SFT. Standard GRPO produces mixed-reward groups and parameter updates, with an uncertain clean test accuracy change. A generation audit reveals that canonical option scores can follow a different token path from generated answers. With scores taken along the greedy generation path, the evidence target improves on the training set; its gains over standard GRPO remain inconsistent on validation data at matched training doses. Sample-level analyses trace how evidence scores, decision margins, and generated answers change during post-training. This empirical and measurement audit identifies gaps between optimization activity, target acquisition, and useful held-out visual behavior.
2609.31450.paper_summary_zh: 醫療視覺語言模型 (VLM) 的後訓練通常通過答案準確性來評估。<lb/>我們檢查準確性和訓練目標的變化如何與在受控的 Qwen2.5-VL-3B 研究中基於圖像的決策相關，該研究針對 PMC-VQA。<lb/>我們比較了僅限於語言模型的監督微調 (SFT) 與低秩適應 (LoRA)、擴展的多模態適應範圍、標準僅答案的群體相對政策優化 (GRPO) 以及反事實證據目標。<lb/>在 2,000 個乾淨測試問題中，語言模型的 LoRA SFT 對正確圖像的準確性改變為 +1.10 個百分點 (95% 配對自助 CI: -0.85 到 +3.05)，而視覺效益事件減少 2.40 個點，圖像敏感性減少 5.60 個點。<lb/>配對記錄顯示獲得 155 個和失去 203 個視覺效益事件。<lb/>更廣泛的適應性產生的正確圖像準確性低於語言模型的 LoRA SFT。<lb/>標準 GRPO 產生混合獎勵組和參數更新，乾淨測試準確性變化不確定。<lb/>生成審計顯示，經典選項分數可以沿著與生成答案不同的標記路徑進行。<lb/>在貪婪生成路徑上獲得的分數中，證據目標在訓練集上有所改善；其在標準 GRPO 上的增益在匹配的訓練劑量的驗證數據中仍然不一致。<lb/>樣本級分析追蹤證據分數、決策邊際和生成答案在後訓練期間的變化。<lb/>這項實證和測量審計識別了優化活動、目標獲取和有用的保留視覺行為之間的差距。
